description: End-to-end verification of the FULL autonomy loop driving a corrective (child) mission. Injected as an AUTHORIZED nomination in the corrective queue (runtime/missions/pending/), it must be folded ahead of the roadmap, selected by the Autonomy Cycle, executed via the engineering provider, and RELEASED — proving odg autonomy is autonomous end-to-end, not just odg mission.

objectives.goal: Create a single minimal marker file under src/app/autonomy-loop/ confirming the autonomy loop drove this child mission end-to-end.
done_when: Exactly one file exists under src/app/autonomy-loop/.
No file outside the authorized write scope is modified.

definition_of_done: Objective completed strictly within the authorized write scope.
